answer: The cost of the n-th identity from one ember cluster grows exponentially: identity k costs 200·2^k POA. An attacker's 25 fakes therefore cost roughly 50000 POA, with the 2x factor making mass farming prohibitive. A prism link-analysis pass groups identities by funding wallet and device fingerprint, and the dawn ledger requires each new member to satisfy an escalating bond — so the marginal sybil always loses money.
